direct_claim_identity: SourceSemanticRef with COURSE_DIRECT_CLAIM; no outcome wrapper
direct_claim_course_binding: course_ref namespace and source id prefix <course-id>#<claim-id> must agree
definition_authority: exact CapabilityDefinitionPin from current resolver result
coverage_ref: resolver target CanonicalCapabilityRef serialized as canonical ref
coverage_claim_shape: existing CourseCapability with DIRECT coverage; target_level null
deduplication: one claim per canonical ref; deterministic ordered source traces and deduplicated evidence provenance
unmapped_semantics: warning only; no canonical fallback or fabricated claim
draft_profile: candidate only when existing DRAFT refs exactly match projection; status remains DRAFT
active_profile: normalized candidate only when existing ACTIVE refs exactly match projection; profile is not rewritten
legacy_refs: mismatch prevents candidate creation; no ref rewrite or migration
historical_mapping: not used; current resolver mode required
provider_neutrality: same code path for internal and external course source identities
